name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based predictive input buffer for presses and wave releases. Up to 1 second of buffer, fully configurable in the mod settings.

enabled.name: Enable Input Buffer
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, every click and release reaches the game completely untouched.

title-buffer.name: Buffer Strength
title-buffer.description: How far a click may be delayed to save you. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS. 240 ticks = 1 second.

normal-ticks.name: Buffer Ticks (All Modes)
normal-ticks.description: Maximum delay in ticks for every gamemode except Wave. 0 turns the buffer off for these modes.

wave-ticks.name: Buffer Ticks (Wave)
wave-ticks.description: Maximum delay in ticks while in Wave / Mini Wave. 0 turns the buffer off for Wave.

title-spam.name: Wave Spam Guard
title-spam.description: Lets fast wave spam bypass the buffer so the buffer never eats your spam.

spam-guard.name: Spam Guard
spam-guard.description: When you spam the wave quickly, the buffer steps aside. Single clicks and normal wave turns stay fully protected.

spam-interval.name: Spam Speed (ticks)
spam-interval.description: Inputs closer together than this many ticks count as spam. Higher = the guard triggers more easily.
spam-interval.enable-if-description: Needs both "Enable Input Buffer" and "Spam Guard".

spam-streak.name: Spam Streak
spam-streak.description: How many fast inputs in a row it takes before the guard steps in. Higher = the guard triggers less easily.
spam-streak.enable-if-description: Needs both "Enable Input Buffer" and "Spam Guard".

title-performance.name: Performance
title-performance.description: Keep the frame rate steady, especially on phones.

lookahead-ms.name: Lookahead Time Limit (ms)
lookahead-ms.description: How long the buffer may search for a safe delay on each click. Lower = steadier frame rate on weak phones. Higher = searches further, which helps very high tick values.

scan-stride.name: Search Step (Large Delays)
scan-stride.description: For delays above 16 ticks, only every Nth delay is tested. 1 = most thorough but slowest.

show-hud.name: Show Status Label
show-hud.description: Shows the current buffer ticks (all modes / wave) and how many clicks the buffer has saved this run.

hud-corner.name: Label Position
hud-corner.description: Which screen corner the status label sits in.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Writes a line to the Geode log every time the buffer saves a click. Can cause tiny hitches, so leave it off for normal play.
